headline: UPDATE: WTI rips to fresh highs $78.15 (+3.51%), clearing 75.85-75.95 supply zone; Khamenei still hasn't signed Hormuz pact
gist: WTI $77.86 (+3.51% vs prev close $75.22), fresh session high $78.15, above VWAP $76.54, upper third of day range $74.57-78.15. Cleared the 75.85-75.95 supply zone flagged capping price since the 18:14/21:08 IST briefs. Demand 74.60-74.90 held early session. Iran's Khamenei still hasn't signed off the Hormuz reopening pact; Trump's ultimatum continues to frame the risk premium. Nat gas flat near $2.655 (-1.23%), no fresh catalyst. Gold $4,298.20 (-0.16%) and Silver $61.59 (-1.12%) drifted lower, below VWAP, on firmer-than-expected jobless claims (199k vs ~202k est) tempering Fed Sept rate-cut bets. Source: CNBC/Axios/Yahoo Finance.

headline: UPDATE: Iran publishes restrictive Hormuz draft plan (bans US/Israeli ships, 20% cargo penalty); US rejects it, WTI holds near $78
gist: WTI $78.01 (+0.93% vs Thu close $77.29), day range $74.73-78.23, above pseudo-VWAP $76.71, testing supply 77.90-78.20 repeatedly. Iranian state media published a draft Hormuz transit plan banning US/Israeli ships and imposing 20% cargo-value penalties on other 'harmful' nations; the US officially rejected the terms, saying no party controls the international waterway. Brent settled Thu +3.8% at $82.49, WTI +2.8% at $77.29 -- extending the multi-day rally from Tue's ~$75 low flagged in yesterday's briefs. Demand 75.00-75.15 held early. Source: CNBC/Axios.

headline: GIFT Nifty, Asia, Wall St all signal a negative pre-market open on oil-driven risk-off
gist: GIFT Nifty ~24,664.50 (-75pts) signaled a negative open; Nikkei -1.3%, Kospi -1.7% on oil-driven risk-off. Wall St (Thu, Aug 6 close) snapped its win streak: Dow -0.9% to 53,885 (ends 5-day rally), S&P500 -0.18% to 7,709.96, Nasdaq -0.06% to 26,348.35, as oil's surge and rising Treasury yields weighed alongside earnings. At today's 09:23 IST open: Nifty 24,587.80 (-0.20%), thin opening range 24,535.05-24,600.90; Bank Nifty 57,850.70 (-0.37%), lower half of opening range 57,794.70-57,954.20. Sensex live feed lagging at open (last confirmed Thu close 78,954.76, +0.48%); estimated tracking Nifty's gap-down. Source: Business Standard/CNBC/Yahoo Finance.

headline: Q1 FY27 earnings beats: LIC +22.8% PAT, Trent +26% (stock +2.4%), Hero MotoCorp +29%, Britannia +14%
gist: LIC Q1 net profit +22.8% YoY to Rs13,492cr (VNB +61% to Rs3,136cr, margin +750bps to 22.9%). Trent standalone PAT +26% YoY to Rs532cr on revenue +19% to Rs5,666cr (EBITDA +36%); stock +2.4% to Rs3,179.70 post-results. Hero MotoCorp standalone net profit +29% YoY to Rs1,454cr on revenue Rs12,999cr (volumes +23% to 16.77 lakh units), despite aluminium/steel cost pressure. Britannia consolidated net profit +14.08% YoY to Rs593-599cr on revenue +8.17% to Rs4,999.97cr. All results announced after Thursday's (Aug 6) close, first reflected in this brief. Source: Business Standard/Upstox/Zeebiz.

gist: Aug 6 (Thursday) cash market: FII net sell Rs17.86cr (near-flat, a sharp reversal from Wed's Rs1,109cr net sell), DII net buy Rs4,013.6cr (up from Wed's Rs3,186cr) -- continued domestic support offsetting muted foreign flows. Source: NSE/Trendlyne.

Both continuing to track Wed's soft 44k ADP jobs print and Fed Sept rate-cut bets; same core driver as prior briefs, now extending higher into Friday's pre-market. Source: CNBC/Bloomberg.

headline: UPDATE: Iran strikes 'hostile targets' near Hormuz after Qeshm Island blasts; Brent tops $83, WTI $78.35
gist: WTI $78.35 (+1.37% vs Thu close $77.29), above VWAP $78.32, upper-mid day range $77.73-78.77. Escalation beyond the 09:23 IST brief's 'draft plan/US rejection' story: explosions rocked Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz entrance late Thursday, and Iranian forces reportedly struck 'hostile targets' in response. Brent extended to above $83, building on Thursday's settle of $82.49. Turkey's Erdogan heads to Saudi Arabia and Pakistan is mediating as diplomacy races to defuse the standoff paralysing shipping through the strait. Source: Bloomberg/Gulf News.

headline: SBI Q1 FY27 PAT +12.5% YoY to Rs19,160cr on treasury gains, but NIM slips to 2.9%; stock drags Bank Nifty

NIM declined to 2.9% (management reaffirmed 3% FY guidance, expects H2 improvement) -- margin softness weighing on the stock and Bank Nifty despite the headline profit beat. headline: RBI draft norms curb NBFC revolving credit; Bajaj Finance -5%, Bajaj Finserv -3%, ~Rs33K cr m-cap erased
gist: RBI draft amendments to Credit Facilities Directions for NBFCs propose that NBFCs (other than card issuers -- only SBI Card, BoB Cards) may offer only term loans, not revolving credit products; flexi loans (~25% of Bajaj Finance's AUM) are the key product at risk. Bajaj Finance fell ~5% intraday (m-cap -~Rs33,000cr), Bajaj Finserv -3%+ on the read-through. Comments open till Aug 28. Fresh, discrete regulatory catalyst compounding the existing oil-led risk-off and SBI NIM-miss drag on Nifty/Sensex/Bank Nifty. Nifty 24,537.10 (-0.40%), Sensex 78,511.90 (-0.56%), Bank Nifty 57,838.55 (-0.39%). Source: Business Standard/IndMoney.

headline: July NFP shock: payrolls -23K vs +83K expected; Fed Sept cut odds surge to ~90%
gist: July nonfarm payrolls fell 23K (vs +83K expected consensus), the biggest miss in months; unemployment ticked down to 4.1% only because the labor force participation rate fell to 61.4%, its lowest in 5+ years. CME FedWatch Sept 25bp rate-cut odds jumped to ~90% (from ~45% a day earlier); DXY and 10-yr Treasury yields both slid sharply on the print. Brand-new macro catalyst, first reflected in this brief. Source: CNBC/BLS/CME.

headline: UPDATE: WTI eases to ~$77 as Iran-Oman push a Hormuz reopening deal despite fee dispute
